errors.title: Module not found
causes: package installed in a different environment
PYTHONPATH or packaging path wrong for src layout

errors.title: None attribute access
causes: function returned None where a value was expected
optional lookup (dict.get/find) used without a guard

errors.title: Type/shape mismatch
causes: value parsed as str where int/list was expected

errors.title: Syntax/indentation error
causes: mixed tabs and spaces or unbalanced delimiters
edited file not parsed before deploy

errors.title: Permission denied
causes: file/dir access rights wrong for the runtime user
writing to a read-only mount or system path

errors.title: Encoding/decode failure
causes: file not UTF-8 - pass encoding= or errors= explicitly

errors.title: Recursion limit
causes: unbounded recursion - convert to a loop or raise the limit
cyclic data structure traversed without a visited set
